description: This file defines a web scraper function for the 'damndelicious.net' website, which fetches and parses recipe data from the site using cheerio and puppeteer.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema class for storing recipe data, including image, name, servings, time, ingredients, and instructions.

methods.name: damnDelicious
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches a recipe page from damndelicious.net, parses the HTML to extract recipe details, and returns a Recipe object.
